title: Warning Relatives about the Fire
summary: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ emphasized personal responsibility for one's deeds and warned his close relatives, including Hazrat Fatimah, to save themselves from Hell. He clarified that family ties would not benefit in the Hereafter unless one has done good deeds.
translation: Today, we consider family ties as a means of worldly honor and reputation; however, these will not benefit us in the Hereafter as much as our own deeds prepared for it will. Thus, when the verse 'And warn your nearest kindred' was revealed, the blessed hadith states: When this verse 'And warn your nearest kindred' was revealed, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ convened the Quraysh. They gathered, and he addressed them generally and specifically by tribe, calling, 'O sons of Abd Shams, O sons of Ka'b bin Lu'ayy, save yourselves from the Fire. O sons of Murrah bin Ka'b, save yourselves from the Fire. O sons of Abd Manaf, save yourselves from the Fire. O sons of Hashim,' and so on, naming them to save themselves from the Fire. Even Hazrat Fatimah (may Allah be pleased with her) was present, and he said, 'O Fatimah, save yourself from the Fire, for I possess no power over you from Allah in any manner, except that you have a kinship with me which I will uphold.' He emphasized that his position as a Prophet and the virtuous daughter he was blessed with, and the unique favors granted to him by Allah do not give him power over the affairs of others in the Hereafter. The kinship bond is honored in this world, not in the Hereafter. Therefore, relying solely on familial connections for worldly prestige will not benefit us in the Hereafter. We should engage in deeds to please Allah and continuously accumulate good actions for the Hereafter. May Allah include us among His accepted servants and grant us salvation from Hell.

وَخَصَّا کہ سب کے سب اکٹھے ہو گئے اور آپ نے عمومی انداز میں خاص خاص قبیلوں کے نام لے کر فرمایا قَالْ يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ شَمْسِ يَا بَنِي قَعْبِ بْنِ لُعَيِّ أَنْقِذُوا أَنفُسَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَا
